decisions.reason: As an adjustable quarter-pallet cardboard display that sits squarely within our core design and production knowledge, we are more likely to retain and adapt it through in-house learning than withdraw it despite its weaker recent standalone visibility.

The pegboard-back display remains closely related to our established cardboard display competence, so our absorptive capacity for customer feedback, redesign, and efficient production supports keeping it in the portfolio.

Although this quarter-pallet display overlaps with nearby variants and may face portfolio rationalisation, it still builds directly on our existing know-how and is more likely to be refined or repositioned than dropped.

This media-focused quarter-pallet display is somewhat more exposed because its application niche may narrow, but it is still close enough to our core offer that we would usually try commercial adjustment before discontinuation.
